data.gender_notes: Arush is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arush is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘arudh’ meaning 'to rise' and ‘sh’ meaning 'king'. This name is bestowed upon a child who is destined to rise and rule, just like the sun. The name Arush carries the meaning “Melodic, King” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arush usually hope their child will grow to embody melodic, king and live with faith, good character and purpose.
